6: KHLESTAKOV. How so, nothing? I see money has dropped out of it. AMMOS [shaking all over]. Oh no, oh no, not at all! [Aside.] Oh, Lord! Now I'm under arrest and they've brought a wagon to take me.
5: KHLESTAKOV. What have you got in your hand there? AMMOS [getting all mixed up and dropping the bills on the floor]. Nothing.
4: JUDGE. After serving three terms I was decorated with the Vladimir of the third class with the approval of the government. [Aside.] I have the money in my hand and my hand is on fire. KHLESTAKOV. I like the Vladimir. Anna of the third class is not so nice.
3: JUDGE. I was elected by the nobility in 1816 and I have served ever since. KHLESTAKOV. Does it pay to be a judge?
2: JUDGE [comes in and stops. Talking to himself]. Oh, God, bring me safely out of this! How my knees are knocking together! [Drawing himself up and holding the sword in his hand. Aloud.] I have the honor to present myself—Judge of the District Court here, College Assessor Liapkin-Tiapkin. KHLESTAKOV. Please be seated. So you are the Judge here?
